## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.19
**New** - **Restore minimized windows** — bring minimized windows back from the keyboard or the menu: "Restore Minimized (Frontmost App)" and "Restore Minimized (All Apps)" (⌃⌥⇧⌫). The Restore shortcut (⌃⌥⌫) now also un-minimizes a window when there's nothing tiled to un-do, and an optional "Restore minimized windows on focus" setting brings an arranged window back when you focus its slot.
**Fixed** - **Permission guidance** — the "Add … to Full Disk Access / Accessibility" helper no longer blocks macOS's "Quit & Reopen" request, so granting access now takes effect on the first try. - **Accessibility "Grant Access"** — no longer stacks the system prompt, the Settings pane, and the guidance panel all at once.
**Improved** - **Permissions** — the Essential / Recommended / Only-when-needed headers are color-coded so the list is easier to scan. - **Global Shortcuts window** — reliably takes focus and scrolls when opened, and long action names no longer get clipped.
